listing.name: Super Mario 64 (Super Mario 64: Recompiled)
listing.summary: Upstream route: Upstream runtime package for Super Mario 64: Recompiled; use own game files per documented setup, with upstream/player owning installation and runtime replacement. Observed release artifacts are evidence, not operational package selection or Portcove support. Limits: Upstream only: Upstream reports Bob-omb Battlefield through its first boss star and return to castle. This is bounded progress, not full campaign proof. Upstream only describes Bob-omb Battlefield through King Bob-omb star, not a full campaign. Separate from existing sm64 decompilation ports; Windows/Linux x64 release plus browser route. Upstream platforms: Windows/Linux x86-64 packages and WebGPU browser. Linux needs glibc 2.35+, Vulkan, GTK 3 and FreeType. Original data: N64 Super Mario 64 USA ROM, SHA1 9bef1128717f958171a4afac3ed78ee2bb4e86ce. Exact source revision/hash and BIOS/firmware requirements not stated above remain Unknown in this review. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
